title: added an interactive build diary to the community page
summary: transparency means seeing the messy parts too. also remapped upstream 429s to 502s. if the provider is choked, that's a bad gateway, not you spamming. clarity helps

highlights.title: Build Diary
highlights.text: The [Community page](https://hello.pollinations.ai) now features an interactive timeline of the project's history. Navigate daily changes and digests with keyboard controls.

highlights.title: Readable Errors
highlights.text: The [API](https://gen.pollinations.ai) now extracts actual human-readable messages from upstream JSON errors. No more raw dumps when providers fail.

highlights.title: Seed Tier Logic
highlights.text: GitHub activity qualification now uses a rolling 90-day window instead of resetting yearly. Your status is safe in January.
